request.style: English, Solo female voice with ethereal choir, Celtic harp, bodhran, tin whistle, fiddle, uilleann pipes, contemplative and majestic, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I suffer as I do
For the truth I hold so true
Not ashamed in this trial
My spirit stands firm and still

[Chorus]
I know the one I trust
He will hold the sacred dust
Guard what was given to me
Until the day we see

[Verse]
I know the one I trust
He will hold the sacred dust
Guard what was given to me
Until the day we see

[Chorus]
I know the one I trust
He will hold the sacred dust
Guard what was given to me
Until the day we see

[Verse]
I am convinced in my heart
That God will keep my part
Until that final day
When the night turns to day

[Chorus]
I know the one I trust
He will hold the sacred dust
Guard what was given to me
Until the day we see

[Bridge]
Not ashamed in the pain
For I know the Lord again
He guards what I hold dear
Until the time is near

[Outro]
Guard what has been entrusted
Until that day we trust
